text:
A hangover from the 1930s, the 103E
had rod brakes, a side-valve engine,
three gears, and pre-war styling.
It was basic and very cheap, and
remained in production until 1959.

images.title: Wolseley 1500 1957
images.caption: Morris recycled the Minor’s floorpan and fitted it with a bigger engine to make this upmarket Wolseley (also available under the Riley name); a popular car, it sold over 140,000.
